entities.name: Johann Adolf II, Duke of Saxe-Weissenfels
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Johann Adolf II was the last duke of Saxe-Weissenfels from 1736 to 1746. Following his death without surviving male issue, the Duchy returned to Electoral Saxony. Johann Adolf was also a commander in the Saxon Army.
